% \title redefined to call the saved \title with a blank line and an
% environment, with hyperref: every title starts with a \par. The document
% builds, and the page's title holds the text.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\let\oldtitle\title
\renewcommand\title[1]{\oldtitle{

{\begin{flushright}\Large #1\end{flushright}}}}
\title{Heading text}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
Some text.
\end{document}
